messages:
Maya (People Ops): Heads up — we're running a short 'Spark Recognition Week' next Monday to spotlight spot awards and small wins. Goal: 20 quick spot awards across teams, small e-gift + shoutout. Nomination form live: https://forms.internal/spark-noms :sparkles:

Sam (People Ops): Quick logistics — budget is $800 total (max $40 per award). I'll handle the gift cards and send them out Wed. Need a volunteer to triage nominations on Monday afternoon.

Priya (Eng Manager): I can help triage from 1–3pm PT on Monday. Will tag any tricky cases for you, Maya.

Luis (Engineering): Can we allow ICs to nominate? Some teams prefer peer-to-peer.

Maya (People Ops): Yes — open to everyone. Form already allows "nominee" and "nominator" fields. We only require manager confirmation for awards > $25.

Evelyn (Product): Minor ask — can we include a checkbox for "public mention in all-hands"? Some folks prefer private thanks.

Maya (People Ops): Good idea. Updated form. We'll default to private if not selected.

kudos-bot: New nomination received from Priya for "Chris" — reason: helped unblock model rollout.

Priya (Eng Manager): Adding another: Sam, FYI I'll forward 6 noms from my org that look good. Most are $25.

Sam (People Ops): Perfect. Maya, can you confirm the Slack shoutout text template? We want consistent formatting.

Maya (People Ops): Template: "Shoutout: @Nominee — Reason (1–2 lines). Reward: $XX e-gift. :tada:" Feel free to tweak per team.

Luis (Engineering): One more thing — timeline? When do winners get announced?

Maya (People Ops): Announce Wed morning in #general, send e-gifts Wed afternoon. Triage Monday, Sam finalizes Tuesday.

Priya (Eng Manager): Sounds good. I'll compile my list and drop it in this thread by EOD Monday.

Sam (People Ops): I'll also prepare a short internal FAQ and a payment runbook (who to contact for replacements).

Maya (People Ops): Thanks all. If anyone else wants to help with shoutouts or the nomination triage slot, ping me. :heart:

kudos-bot: Reminder scheduled: nomination window closes Monday 5:00pm PT.
